packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript on 6.x: TypeScript 7 crashes @typescript-eslint v8 (ESLint: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Cjs')") and breaks astro check. Remove once the toolchain supports it.

Leave package.json overrides to hand edits. Renovate's lockfile update drops packages pinned through a nested override, so npm ci fails ("Missing katex@0.19.1 from lock file") and the PR churns through CI on every push to main. The overrides are hand-set security floors (caret ranges), so in-range patches still arrive through lock-file maintenance; bump a range by hand when a new major is needed.
Merge bookmarklets bumps as soon as CI passes. git-refs digests have no release timestamp, so skip the shared preset's minimumReleaseAge, which would otherwise hold them.

customManagers.description: Track the benbalter/bookmarklets commit vendored in src/data/bookmarklets.json. Renovate only bumps the commit; CI (script/update-bookmarklets --check) fails if the vendored code needs refreshing.
Track benbalter/vale-styles release zips (BenBalter, AIPatterns) pinned by URL in .vale.ini.
Vale CLI version installed in CI (VALE_VERSION in workflow env).
Harper CLI version installed in CI (HARPER_VERSION in workflow env). Release tags carry the v prefix, so the value is tracked as written.
Lighthouse CI runs through npx with an inline version, so it isn't in package.json for the npm manager to see.
zizmor is installed with pip inline in the supply-chain workflow.
